blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The camp of Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday accused the Marcos administration of using the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to persecute her politically, calling the bureau’s findings on her alleged misdeclared properties a “shameless smear campaign.” Duterte’s spokesperson, Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr., questioned NBI Director Melvin Matibag’s decision to publicize the alleged discrepancies in her Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALNs) before formally informing her of the allegations and giving her an opportunity to respond.
